acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All included subtasks run without new approval
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: AgentRunner re-fetches confirmed Goal execution state before every implementation turn, inherits the exact approval, and uses a stable per-turn gateway authorization check identity.
DeliveryCoordinator checks strictly-derived authorization before each bounded repair cycle with a distinct stable cycle identity.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: New scope and higher ceilings pause for one Goal decision
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Missing proposals and malformed or incomplete execution windows, budget ceilings, aggregate consumption, and requested consumption now fail closed; pending changes, out-of-scope work, and exhaustion continue to pause.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Pause and resume preserve remaining authorization
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Each logical turn/cycle re-reads canonical aggregate consumption; deterministic turn/cycle operation IDs preserve retry idempotency without replaying decisions across later checks.

residualRisk.risk: The repaired commit is locally ahead of origin until the orchestrator publishes the candidate branch.
residualRisk.mitigation: Keep the exact committed workspace intact; publication and fresh independent review remain owned by the subsequent Symphony delivery coordinator.

summary: Repair cycle 1 closes Goal authorization fail-open paths for absent or malformed canonical state and gives successive gateway checks distinct stable logical-turn identities.
